# This build is VERY EXPERIMENTAL, do not use it for any multiworld you aren't comfortable abandoning after 10 seconds because you wanted to go check on how Lance was doing with those Electrode and now you're stuck sliding infinitely.

# Changelog

## Options
- HM and TM compatibility is now split by same and other type.
- Add `tiers_and_trainers` option to Battle Tower Sanity. This adds 70 locations, one for each trainer in the Battle Tower.

## Adjustments
- Battles in the Battle Tower will now respect your Shift/Set selection. It was specifically overridden to Shift in vanilla.
- The `/fishing` and `/headbutt` commands will now only show locations relevant for the current settings (thanks @snowflav-goob).
- :3

## Bug Fixes
- Fix random Battle Tower tier locations sometimes being sent on save file creation.
- Holding your hold-to-mash button will now advance you through the last textbox of a Battle Tower battle, no press required.
- Sending out a Pokemon no longer waits for the enemy cry to finish playing when battle animations are Speedy.
- Stop all player movement when triggering an event, preventing softlocks when an Ice Trap was active.
- Emit a better error when impossible Plando Connections are provided.
6.0.0-alpha.15.title: 6.0.0-alpha.15

# This build is VERY EXPERIMENTAL, do not use it for any multiworld you aren't comfortable abandoning after 10 seconds because the BANK OF AP took all your money and you can't get it back.

# Changelog

## Options
- Flooded Mine: A new cave connecting Cherrygrove City and Route 32. Requires Surf to access on the Cherrygrove side. Contains 3 hidden Charcoal, a Dig TM and new encounters.
- Rematchsanity: Each Trainer rematch is a location. Adds 76 new locations.
- Reorganised option groups, roadblocks have been split into Johto and Kanto.
- Phone Call Mode is now it's own option as many other options now rely on it.

## Features
- Bank of AP (Energylink). Can be accessed at any PC to deposit and withdraw money from the shared pool.

## Adjustments
- The warps in Saffron Gym will now participate in ER.
- Victory Road regions have been renamed to not be stupid (thanks @snowflav-goob).
- :3

## Bug Fixes
- Logically account for being able to get the Blackthorn flypoint when exiting Dragon's Den.
- Fix an issue where generation could fail if ER caused a species to go out of logic.
- Fix the event for clearing Rocket base logically being in the wrong region.

# This build is VERY EXPERIMENTAL, do not use it for any multiworld you aren't comfortable abandoning after 10 seconds because Mom took all your money and won't give it back.

# Changelog

## Options
- New option: Momsanity. Adds the 10 fixed items that Mom can buy after a battle when saving your money as locations. Each one logically requires an increasing number of accessible gyms, starting at 0.
- New option: Randomize Lucky Number Show. Adds the three Lucky Number Show prizes as locations, each prize requires owning a Pokemon from a randomly chosen in-game trade.
- New option: Vanilla Event Chains. Allows restoring some event chains from the vanilla game. The current options are Misty, Jasmine, Copycat and Clair (who has been moved from her previous dedicated option).
- South Kanto Access now has a `both` option, which puts the landslide on both sides.

## Adjustments
- The Indigo Plateau Flypoint is no longer excluded from Fly-related options.
- Increased the rate at which items are delivered to the game by the client.

## Bug Fixes
- Fix a rare issue where the client may not have detected locations checked while attempting to reconnect to AP.
- Unown from signs are now treated as static encounters, rather than land.

# This build is VERY EXPERIMENTAL, do not use it for any multiworld you aren't comfortable abandoning after 10 seconds because you released the Slowpoke with your King's Rock and Slowking was required.

# Changelog

## Options
- New option: Item Value Plando: Allows you to override the value of any item. Items sell for half their value.
- New option: Lance Requires Elite Four. If enabled, you will be kicked out of Lance's room if you have not beaten all Elite 4 members.
- Evolution items are now accepted by the Build-a-Mart option.

## Adjustments
- Evolution items such as stones are now key items, they can be infinitely reused and there will be at least one of each in any seed.
- Added the Link Cable. This evolves species which would require trading to evolve and those species no longer evolve at level 37. Species which evolve by trade with a held item must hold that item when the Link Cable is used on them to evolve, the held item is not consumed.
- Moves of party members of trainers that have specific movesets (such as gym leaders), now have a 25% chance to be a TM that species can learn per move, instead of it being evenly weighted across all possible moves.
- Item Ball Colors are no longer force disabled by Race Mode.

## Bug Fixes
- You will no longer be locked in Lance's room when entering in ER.
